newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with prices on slaughter steers and heifers not fully established, either live or dressed basis, USDA said. V
ery limited buyer inquiry on Thursday. Seller interest light as most sold their showlists this week.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs few 104.00 early Thursday morning.
Wk To Date- 114,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 87,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 37,200
Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 1.00-2.00 higher. Dressed basis 2.00-4.00 higher.

Trading was slow on Monday, very active on Tuesday when the bulk of trade occurred. Light action on Wednesday tapering off to token trade on Thursday. Buyer inquiry and demand very good this week as packers went about getting a sizeable inventory that covers the better part of, if not all of, next week. Seller interest good at the sharply higher bids offered this week. This week's sales volume included 21,200 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Forward contracts - June July August September
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1350 lbs.
mostly 65.00, few to 66.50 delivered, few to 64.00, late trade 64.00-64.50. Dressed basis mostly 105.00-105.50, few 106.00, few 104.00-104.50, late 104.00. ( weighted average 1228 lbs.--105.17).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs. mostly 65.00, few to 66.00 delivered, few to 64.00, late trade 64.00-64.50. Dressed basis mostly 105.00-105.50, few 106.00, few 104.00-104.50, late 104.00. ( weighted average 1125 lbs--105.17).
